positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for developing UI pages using Angular 7, AngularJS, HTML5, SCSS, JavaScript, Typescript. 
Used Angular 7 and AngularJS as a framework to create Single Page Applications which can bind data to specific views and synchronize data with the server.
Created custom directives, filters, components using Angular 7, AngularJS.
Created Angular service and integration with RESTful APIs.
Created Custom Filters to organize data in a more controlled and precise manner.
Implemented Factory, Service, and Provider to organize code and allow for easier future maintenance. Worked with creating selectors, reducers, actions, and effects using NgRX for the store.
Maintained the code using version control system like Git. 
Worked in an Agile environment using Jira.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Design modern, visually appealing, creative websites within WordPress.
Develop and customize elements on new and existing WordPress websites.
Manipulate a comprehensive library of WordPress themes and plugins given the project specifications.
Troubleshoot advance PHP, MySQL, and CSS issues related to WordPress websites.
Produce original website / mobile site layouts and execute layout revisions to them in a rapid and accurate manner.
Be extremely organized in communicating with internal Project Managers, following detailed instructions, and working within out proprietary CRM, effectively and efficiently.

positions.title: Junior Developer
positions.description:
Design and develop visually appealing responsive websites and branded experiences.
Optimize and test features across all major browsers on desktop and mobile devices.
Collaborate with Lead Front-End Web Developer, Designers, Product Managers and Developers to create branded experiences.
Make sure all user interactions are well-designed and implemented correctly.
Collaborate with peers on best practices and promote knowledge sharing.
Work within existing brand standards to create best possible digital solutions.
Troubleshoot and provide continual maintenance and upgrades of websites.
Stays up to date or current and future UX/UI standards and best practices.
Analyze user impact of different features and treatments using.
